summary: TyreBook frontend-only regression + stabilization pass (mobile 390x844, Firebase empty → AsyncStorage fallback). All 12 review checkpoints PASS. HARD PASS on the wholesale-discount auto-fill: after saving Wholesale=22 in /admin/pricing and reloading (persistence confirmed), visiting /sales/new and tapping the Wholesale chip auto-fills sale-discount input to exactly '22'. Pricing config → sales wiring is functional. /admin/app-settings lowStockThreshold=7 saves and persists (parsed tyrebook.appSettings = {language:'hi'/'mr'|..., lowStockThreshold:7, ...}). Dashboard renders all 4 required KPIs (Old Tyre Sales, Remould Sales, Old Tyre Stock, Remould Stock) with no PAGEERRORS. Language sync verified BOTH directions: /language → hi mirrors to admin/app-settings (chip shows brandTertiary background rgb(204,232,227) vs unselected en rgb(248,250,249); parsed tyrebook.appSettings.language === 'hi' AND legacy tyrebook.language === 'hi'); admin/app-settings → mr save reflects on /language (row has border-width=2px indicating check-circle active state; legacy key === 'mr'). Admin hub /admin now shows admin-tile-vehicles in the Data group (13 tiles total, ≥12 required); tapping the tile lands on /admin/vehicles which renders veh-name/front/rear inputs + 7 category chips (veh-cat-*) + form is interactive. Admin hub still shows owner-badge, admin-kpi-strip (4 pills), admin-bottom-nav. Khata icons render correctly: verified the credit entry created via /sales/new (Payment Mode=Credit, mobile=9999999999, ₹5900) renders on /khata/9999999999 with MDI glyph U+F0737 (arrow-up-bold) using font-family='material-community' — no missing-glyph box, colored error-red as designed. Staff RBAC verified: /admin, /admin/pricing, /admin/vehicles, /admin/app-settings all redirect to /settings when logged in as staff@test.com. Global tab navigation (Dashboard, Inventory, Billing, Reports, Settings) as staff produced ZERO pageerrors.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, .$local-1785163957603/604' fires on multiple screens (admin hub navigation, tab nav). Non-fatal but indicates non-unique keys in a list — likely two AsyncStorage-generated ids collided (id = `local-${Date.now()}`) when items are created in the same ms. Suggest switching id generator to `local-${Date.now()}-${counter}` or `crypto.randomUUID()` in /app/frontend/src/utils/storage.ts or wherever local ids are minted (e.g. seedStarterVehicles / khata local ids).
props.pointerEvents deprecation and Image style.resizeMode warnings — dependency-level, unchanged from iter_2/iter_3.

action_items: Fix duplicate React key warning: local id generator produces same value when two records are created in the same millisecond (observed key collisions like .$local-1785163957603 / 604). Suffix with an incrementing counter or use crypto.randomUUID().

(Optional) Admin hub tile count is now 13 (Overview 2 + Data 4 + People 3 + Configuration 3 + System 1); review request said '12 tiles' — either update the spec doc or drop one tile. Not a bug, just a doc/spec mismatch.

(Optional, cosmetic) Storage util double-encodes values (JSON.stringify wraps an already JSON string) so tyrebook.appSettings raw looks like '"{\"language\":\"hi\"...}"'. Consumers must JSON.parse twice. Consider storing objects directly.
critical_code_review_comments: sales/new.tsx: `getPricingConfig()` runs on mount and sets `gstPercent` from `cfg.defaultGstPercent` — but there is no re-load when pricing is changed while the sales screen is already open. Because the screen is a stack push, this is fine in practice, but if user opens Sales, changes pricing in another tab, then returns to Sales, the value is stale. Consider useFocusEffect for hydration.

settings.ts saveAppSettings mirrors `language` into legacy LANGUAGE_KEY, but setLanguage() only mirrors when `current.language !== code`. If appSettings has never been persisted (first-time user) current.language is 'en', but writing to APP_KEY still happens correctly. Verified working.
khata/[id].tsx: arrow-up-thin → arrow-up-bold migration verified rendering U+F0737 with font-family 'material-community'. No missing-glyph box.

admin/vehicles.tsx: seedStarterVehicles() runs on every focus — if the seeder is not idempotent it could duplicate rows. Please verify guard (should be a no-op if any vehicle already exists). Not tested here.

Admin route guard uses `if (user && user.role !== 'owner') return <Redirect ...>`; when `user` is null (during hydration or logged out) the screen briefly renders. For /admin/pricing and /admin/app-settings this means an unauthenticated user CAN reach the form and save to localStorage before the guard resolves. Because there is no server (AsyncStorage-only), this is not a security issue for the demo, but flag for when Firebase is wired: unauthenticated users must be redirected to /login, not just non-owners to /settings.
AdminBottomNav is present on /admin/pricing, /admin/app-settings, /admin/vehicles — good. Verify /admin/vehicles too (currently uses its own custom header without AdminBottomNav).

Wrote tyrebook.pricingConfig (Wholesale=22), tyrebook.appSettings (lowStockThreshold=7, language toggled hi→mr), tyrebook.language (mr). All in localStorage.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs surfaced. Duplicate-React-key console warning is the only cosmetic issue; RCA: local id generator uses `local-${Date.now()}` which collides for entries created in the same millisecond (e.g. seed batches). Mitigation: append counter or crypto.randomUUID().
